svg.title: P02: Streaming concurrent batch loop
svg.desc: Analytical UML class view of the proposed pattern contract; not an observed implementation or execution trace.
svg.text: Primitive / UML CLASS VIEW / ANALYTICAL MODEL

text.tspan: Overlap output and independent work.

svg.text: dashed arrow: call dependency · brown: return/failure · analytical, not an observed trace

text.tspan: Multiple model, tool, or batch tasks are authorized to run concurrently.
A batch is dispatched or streamed.
Invocation identity, cancellation control, and result correlation.
Streamed or completed results are merged without losing or duplicating
ownership.
The runtime exposes concurrency and a way to await or cancel outstanding
work.
Every accepted invocation is linked to its result or explicit failure.
The harness does not declare completion while unreconciled work remains.
Partial failure and cancellation produce explicit terminal states and
cleanup.
1 HarnessRuntime → BatchScheduler submit(batch)
2 BatchScheduler → Worker dispatch(invocation)
3 Worker → ResultMerger deliver(result)
4 BatchScheduler → ResultMerger register(identity)
5 Worker ↩ FailureHandler report(error)
6 FailureHandler ↩ ResultMerger reconcile(failure)
7 ResultMerger → HarnessRuntime stream(ordered)
Batch size, asyncio or promise scheduler, streaming reducer, and ordering policy.
Test one failure, cancellation, completion order, and concurrent side effects.
Generic concurrency in an unrelated subsystem does not count.
